question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3-7 business days. Express delivery (1-2 days) is available for extra charge at checkout.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Reply with your Order ID (e.g. ORD-1234) and I will show you the real-time status. You can also check the tracking link sent to your email after dispatch.

question: Do you offer free shipping?
answer: Yes! Free standard shipping on all orders above Rs 499. Orders below Rs 499 have a flat Rs 49 shipping fee.

question: What are your dispatch hours?
answer: Orders placed before 2 PM Mon-Sat are dispatched same day. Orders after 2 PM or on Sundays are dispatched the next business day.

question: Which cities do you deliver to?
answer: We deliver pan-India to all cities and towns. Enter your pincode at checkout to confirm availability in your area.

question: How do I return a product?
answer: You can return most items within 7 days of delivery. Items must be unused in original packaging with all tags. Initiate return from your order confirmation email.

question: When will I get my refund?
answer: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item. Amount is credited to your original payment method.

question: Can I exchange a product for a different size?
answer: Yes! Size exchanges are free within 7 days of delivery for clothing. Contact support with your order ID and desired size.

question: What if I received a damaged product?
answer: We sincerely apologise! Please share a photo of the damaged item within 48 hours of delivery. We will arrange a free replacement immediately.

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: Yes you can cancel before dispatch. Once shipped cancellation is not possible but you can return it after delivery for a full refund.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept UPI (GPay PhonePe Paytm) credit and debit cards net banking EMI and Cash on Delivery.

question: Is Cash on Delivery available?
answer: Yes! COD is available for orders up to Rs 10000. A convenience fee of Rs 40 applies. Pay cash when your order arrives.

question: Is online payment secure?
answer: Absolutely! We use 256-bit SSL encryption and are PCI-DSS compliant. Your card details are never stored on our servers.

question: Do you have EMI options?
answer: Yes! No-cost EMI is available on orders above Rs 3000 on select credit cards including HDFC ICICI SBI Axis and Kotak. Choose at checkout.

question: Can I pay with UPI?
answer: Yes! We support all UPI apps including Google Pay PhonePe Paytm BHIM and more. Select UPI at checkout and scan or enter your UPI ID.

question: Are products on your store genuine?
answer: Yes! All products are 100% genuine sourced directly from brand authorised distributors. We offer brand warranty on all electronics.

question: Is a product available in my area?
answer: We ship pan-India. Enter your pincode at checkout to confirm delivery availability in your location.

question: How do I check stock availability?
answer: Product pages show real-time stock. If something is out of stock tap Notify Me in the bot and we will WhatsApp you when it restocks.

question: Do products come with a warranty?
answer: Electronics come with standard manufacturer warranty (usually 1 year). Extended warranty is available at checkout for select products.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: We offer a 7-day hassle-free return policy for most products. Items must be unused with original tags and packaging. Electronics must be unopened for returns.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: You can type your issue here and I will help! For complex issues type 4 to connect with a human agent or email support@shopbot.in
